canonical_decision.track_a: The 16 module architecture 11-26 in the approved 2026-11-05 decision is canonical for the XAI/Understanding AI sequence.
canonical_decision.track_b: Core modules 27-39 are a proposed/working MI sequence; shared foundations 0-10 and transition 19-26 are prerequisites, not duplicated coursework.
canonical_decision.foundation: Modules 0-10 are shared foundation and remain provisional until outcomes, labs and actual catalog IDs are fully specified.
canonical_decision.track_c: Separate C0-C12 program, not counted among 40 A/B research modules.
canonical_decision.hierarchy: Track → Theme → Module → Lesson. Preserve legacy IDs and URLs; use catalog UID as stable key.
canonical_decision.legacy_spec: The separate repository CURRICULUM_SPECIFICATION.md is a historical/reconstructed 40-module draft. Its Track A module sequence 11-26 conflicts with approved architecture and must not be treated as canonical.

track_c_gaps: Track C specification lists modules but no canonical catalog Theme/Module/Lesson UIDs yet.
Need explicit model licence and supply-chain review, pinned versions, hashes and provenance.
Need structured output validation and output handling.
Need auth boundaries, least privilege, secrets, network egress, filesystem sandboxing, MCP authorization and consent.
Need RAG ingestion security, chunking/index versioning, ACL-aware retrieval, deletion/update, citation verification and poisoning tests.
Need evaluation dataset, retrieval qrels, recall@k/nDCG/MRR, context precision/recall, groundedness, answer relevance/completeness, citation correctness, latency and cost.
Need agent/tool-call evaluation and policy enforcement before any autonomous actions.
Need CPU/small model fallback, model memory, context/KV cache, throughput and concurrency benchmarks.
